Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
fix(Worker): Remove obsolete precache paths from Service Worker

The `CORE_PRECACHE` array contained pre-bundle paths (`/Worker/Policy.js`, `/Worker/Register.js`, `/Worker/CSS/Load.js`) that no longer exist under Vite/Astro. These scripts are now inlined into a single hashed `_astro/WorkerBundleImports.astro_*.js` chunk, making the standalone `/Worker/*.js` URLs invalid.

Keeping these paths in `cache.addAll(...)` caused every service worker install to emit `[Worker] Core Precaching failed: TypeError: Failed to fetch` and polluted Mountain.log with three SPA-fallback DEBUG triplets per boot.

Replaced the array with an empty readonly array and added comments explaining that the runtime fetch handler caches assets on demand instead.
